decisions.reason: After another year without clear evidence of strong adoption, uncertainty has fallen, but the low cost of maintaining an SMS API close to existing services still makes the option worth keeping open.
As a recently launched, low-cost extension of existing messaging services, its prospects remain highly uncertain and keeping it open requires little commitment, so the option is retained.
